name: live_companion_follow
description: The guest's slot recruits the gecko as a follower. The guest then moves into another cell (D00001) while the host stays. The follower goes with its owner, not with the host: on every peer the gecko's cell is the guest's cell. Headless only: it uses the coop cell verb. The host moves a guest's follower when the guest changes place (world::coop::campaign::owners::follow_owners, the move of companions::come_along). The dump's actors.REF.cell is the cell each peer has the actor in.
